additional_info.subject: Status update
additional_info.body:
After call with Jason, identified two main issues with Castles Neftis:
Frequent disconnections
, very similar to the behavior we previously observed with Seitatech.
Mastercard payments are not being accepted.
Escalated to Product Champion, in order to establish a direct communication channel between R&D and Jason, as it is already in place for CCV, Valina and Seitatech.

additional_info.subject: Status Update
additional_info.body:
Direct channel between RC-GB and R&D established for support on bug resolution.
Bug identification in progress by R&D. As no further action is required from service side, agreed with Jason and Prod Champion to close the ticket.
